description:
Prepare a one-tap booking handoff for the user's chosen campground/dates.

Returns a pre-filled deep link to the operator's reservation page plus the
booking-window context (release date/time, operator rules, alert
suggestion). Does NOT book on behalf: third-party booking is prohibited by
Recreation.gov, ReserveCalifornia, ReserveAmerica, and every other supported
public-land operator.
name: prepare_reservation
title: Prepare Reservation
